arStrings.szText: Explore {icon:Icon_Tooltip_NightmareDungeonEntrance, 2.} {c_highlight}Nightmare Dungeons{/c} and follow the Gateway's trail to discover {icon:Marker_HoradricSecretPortal, 2.} {c_highlight}Horadric Strongrooms{/c}.
Activate {icon:Marker_PYL_GoatStatue, 2.} {c_highlight}Horadric Statues{/c} to turn the tide in the battle ahead.
Defeat enemies and activate Shrines and Pylons within the time limit to earn {c_highlight}Horadric Attunement{/c}.
Complete Horadric strongrooms to gather {c_highlight}Escalation Sigils{/c}.
